codes.description: The requested action is not explicitly authorized by the household portfolio compiler.
One or more prerequisite reductions or operator actions must occur before the requested action.
The requested action falls outside the explicit authorization scope.
A required upstream artifact is stale and invalidates authorization issuance or use.
A governed account restriction blocks the requested action or route.
The asset class or security falls outside the governed policy universe.
The governed liquidity floor reduces deployable capital or forces reductions.
The governed correlated cluster limit is breached or clamped.
The governed single-name concentration limit is breached or clamped.
The governed sleeve allocation or concentration limit is breached or clamped.
The governed protected-position rule blocks discretionary reductions or liquidation.
A rebalance candidate was suppressed by a downstream control or degraded-state policy.
The portfolio remains inside the governed drift band and no action is required.
A forced reduction is required to restore compliance or reduce risk.
Correlation-model absence or correlation compression triggered a conservative clamp.
The household drawdown state triggered a deploy-throttle or emergency mode.
Emergency mode requires risk-reduction actions before discretionary adds.
The household risk envelope blocks new risk deployment.
The total portfolio risk budget is exhausted or exceeded.
The sleeve-level risk budget is exhausted or exceeded.
Imported-position data is incomplete and must be treated conservatively.
A required cash or account balance input is missing.
Required lot-level truth is unavailable for the requested tax-sensitive action.
Required valuation or price input is stale.
A position could not be mapped to a governed household owner or account.
A non-urgent rebalance was deferred because modeled tax cost was excessive.
Required tax truth was unavailable so only urgent risk reductions may proceed.
Lot-level tax truth is required before a tax-sensitive liquidation may proceed.
A risk-reduction action was allowed despite degraded tax truth because urgency was explicit.
